_comment: Release manifest. Every Hub with update checks on fetches this file and compares its own version against `version`. Bump it as part of cutting a release, not before - the harness pins it equal to package.json so a manifest that lies about the current release cannot ship.
notes: 2.24: import your rolls from Spoolman (one way, re-import any time); push notifications to your phone through ntfy when a print finishes, pauses with the reason, errors, or a printer stops answering; rolls count down by themselves when a print finishes, with cost per print and an Undo; wildcards in the library filter; the QR scan button says why it is off on plain http.
